title: NFL offseason power rankings: No. 2 Seattle Seahawks weren't just Super Bowl champions, they were dominant ones

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL offseason power rankings: No. 2 Seattle Seahawks weren't just Super Bowl champions, they were dominant ones
sources.description: The Rams might have stolen some of the attention from the Seahawks over the offseason with some flashy moves. But a rock-solid Seattle team isn't going to back down after the historic season it just had.
